text: He woke up, he tried to count his coin But he couldn't hardly notice it at all Pretty little man, he came from Holy Ann Though he was green, he made a lovely hall The civil little soul, he picked for Willie's role So you couldn't hardly notice it at all A fat girl on a cable car, she thought he was the king But you couldn't hardly notice it at all A narrow-dented dude got up and gave the girl a seat
